pos.p1: Cashiers can scan barcodes directly with any USB or Bluetooth keyboard-wedge scanner. Product lookups query the current branch inventory with live pricing.
pos.p2: Discounts require pos.discount permission and are capped at the store maximum limit. Price overrides require pos.priceOverride permission.
pos.p3: Split tenders allow combining Cash, Card/Mada, and Store Credit. Overpaid cash calculates exact change due to return from the drawer.

shifts.title: Cashier Shifts & Cash Management
shifts.description: Shift opening float, paid-in/paid-out movements, discrepancy thresholds, and Z-Reports.
shifts.p1: Each cashier opens one active shift with an initial cash float before processing sales.
shifts.p2: Mid-shift cash additions (Paid In) and expenses (Paid Out) require a documented reason for audit compliance.
shifts.p3: If closing counted cash differs from expected cash by more than the allowed discrepancy limit, a manager with shift.view permission must review and authorize the close.
shifts.p4: Closing a shift generates an immutable Z-Report with a sequential Z-number, permanently snapshotting all shift metrics.

returns.title: Returns, Exchanges & Credit Notes
returns.description: Restocking items, damaged write-offs, exchange value rules, and loyalty clawbacks.
returns.p1: Items returned in good condition are set to restock (re-added to sellable branch stock). Damaged items are booked as a return and immediate write-off.
returns.p2: Exchanges require that total replacement value equals or exceeds return credit. The customer settles any remaining difference.
returns.p3: Partial returns pro-rate discounts and VAT, taking the exact remaining balance on the final item to guarantee zero-halala drift.
returns.p4: When an order with awarded loyalty points is refunded, the points earned on the refunded amount are automatically reversed.

orders.title: Order Fulfillment & Lifecycle
orders.description: Omnichannel status flow, tracking parcels, shipments, and printable tax invoices.
orders.p1: Online and counter orders transition through standardized lifecycle states: Pending → Paid → Processing → Shipped → Completed.
orders.p2: Adding a shipment with carrier and tracking number marks the order shipped and notifies the customer.
orders.p3: Every invoice and receipt includes a ZATCA Phase-1 compliant TLV QR code when the 15-digit Saudi VAT number is configured.

inventory.title: Stock Ledger & Adjustments
inventory.description: Append-only transactions, branch transfers, purchase orders, and stock-out alerts.
inventory.p1: Stock is managed through an append-only ledger. Inventory movements are immutable records.
inventory.p2: Branch transfers deduct stock from the source branch upon dispatch and add stock to the destination branch upon receipt.
inventory.p3: Stock-out forecasts flag items with <= 3 days of remaining inventory as critical and recommend reorder quantities.

barcodes.title: Barcode Standards & Symbology
barcodes.description: GS1 restricted prefixes 20–29, Code 128 symbology, and thermal label printing.
barcodes.p1: In-store products use GS1 restricted-circulation prefixes (20–29) with sequential check digits.
barcodes.p2: Alphanumeric SKUs and external barcodes print in Code 128 format automatically.
barcodes.p3: Barcode labels can be previewed live and printed directly to thermal label printers via QZ Tray.

translations.title: Arabic Translations & Overrides
translations.description: Automated translation pipeline, protected glossary terms, and manual overrides.
translations.p1: All products, categories, pages, and marketing campaigns auto-translate to Arabic upon save.
translations.p2: Protected brand names are registered in the glossary as never-translate terms to prevent accidental literal translation.
translations.p3: Storefront UI strings can be reviewed and overridden with custom Arabic translations in Settings → Languages without a code deploy.

exports.title: Universal Background Exports
exports.description: Asynchronous Excel/CSV reports, formula injection defense, and secure private download links.
exports.p1: Exports for orders, products, customers, and inventory run asynchronously in the background via BullMQ.
exports.p2: CSV exports include UTF-8 Byte Order Marks (BOM) for Excel Arabic compatibility and prefix dangerous formula characters (=, +, -, @) to prevent injection.
exports.p3: Download links remain privately accessible for 24 hours before automatic expiration.

shortcuts.enter: Add selected search item or submit sale
shortcuts.esc: Clear search query or dismiss dialog
shortcuts.scanner: USB/Bluetooth scanner automatically scans into the till without clicking
